Nicktoons.uk.title: The Loud House
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Lori and Lincoln visit the city. Lori struggles to be a city girl and Lincoln finds Ronnie Anne has changed. (S3, ep 5a).

Nicktoons.uk.title: The Loud House
Nicktoons.uk.desc: The Loud kids make a trip to the supermarket to do the grocery shopping for Mom, but Lincoln has other plans. (S1, ep 18b).

Nicktoons.uk.title: The Loud House
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Lincoln has his hands full when his sisters ask him to cover for them on the same day, in 'Cover Girls', and then in 'Save The Date', Bobby and Lori go on a double date with Ronnie Anne.

Nicktoons.uk.title: The Loud House
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Lincoln has four dates to the dance in 'Dance Dance Resolution', then in 'A Fair to Remember', Lori tries to make Bobby jealous by hanging with Clyde when Lincoln and Bobby become friends.

Nicktoons.uk.title: The Loud House
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Mom and Dad win a trip to a resort and decide to take the kids in 'Suite and Sour', then in 'Back in Black', when Lucy gets a crush on a regular normal boy, her sisters give her a makeover.

Nicktoons.uk.title: The Loud House
Nicktoons.uk.desc: The kids plan to sabotage dinner so that they can have pizza in 'Fed Up', then in 'Shell Shock', Lincoln and Ronnie Anne have to take care of an egg baby but Lincoln doesn't trust her.

Nicktoons.uk.title: The Loud House
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Clyde, desperate to act normal around Lori, gets Leni's help in 'Change of Heart', and in 'Health Kicked', the kids worry that Mom and Dad are hurting their health from not being active.

Nicktoons.uk.title: The Loud House
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Knowing Leni's history of spoiling surprises, the kids don't tell her about Mom's upcoming party. (S2, ep 21b).

Nicktoons.uk.title: The Loud House
